text: You should be in the control room. Do not tarry.
source_text: You should be in the control room. Do not tarry.

text: So, a human. This is very interesting. You will come with me to the Lieutenant, or you will perish right here.
source_text: So, a human. This is very interesting. You will come with me to the Lieutenant, or you will perish right here.

text: Okay, I give up. Let's go.
source_text: Okay, I give up. Let's go.

text: Excellent. Come with me if you want to live.
source_text: Excellent. Come with me if you want to live.

text: You think me moronic, like many of my kind. You are sadly mistaken. It is a terminal problem, I understand.
source_text: You think me moronic, like many of my kind. You are sadly mistaken. It is a terminal problem, I understand.

text: We meet again. You will not escape me this time.
source_text: We meet again. You will not escape me this time.

text: Don't you come near her! I'll kill you first!
source_text: Don't you come near her! I'll kill you first!

text: Flip, when will I get out of here?
source_text: Flip, when will I get out of here?

text: Soon. Very soon. Your time is near.
source_text: Soon. Very soon. Your time is near.

text: I can't wait to be together again.
source_text: I can't wait to be together again.

text: You will not regret your decision, dearest. The dipping is painful . . .
source_text: You will not regret your decision, dearest. The dipping is painful . . .

text: The FEV is very painful, but you will live.
source_text: The FEV is very painful, but you will live.

text: And you will join us. In body and soul.
source_text: And you will join us. In body and soul.

text: 你看到一个巨大的变种人。
source_text: 你看到一个巨大的变种人。

text: 你应该呆在控制室里，别在这晃悠。
source_text: 你应该呆在控制室里，别在这晃悠。

text: 呦，是一个人类啊。真逗，你要么就和我一起去见中尉，要么就自己烂在这。
source_text: 呦，是一个人类啊。真逗，你要么就和我一起去见中尉，要么就自己烂在这。

text: 太好了，想活命就跟我来！
source_text: 太好了，想活命就跟我来！

text: 你认为象我这种块头的都是弱智？你真可悲。你犯了个会要你小命的错误，这我懂。
source_text: 你认为象我这种块头的都是弱智？你真可悲。你犯了个会要你小命的错误，这我懂。

text: 又见面了？这回你可跑不了了！
source_text: 又见面了？这回你可跑不了了！

text: 你再靠近她一步，我马上就杀了你！
source_text: 你再靠近她一步，我马上就杀了你！

text: 弗里普，我什么时候能离开这里？
source_text: 弗里普，我什么时候能离开这里？

text: 快了，马上，你的时候就要到了。
source_text: 快了，马上，你的时候就要到了。

text: 你不会为你的决定而后悔的，亲爱的，去泡一下可是很痛的哦……
source_text: 你不会为你的决定而后悔的，亲爱的，去泡一下可是很痛的哦……

text: FEV会让你很痛，不过你不会死。
source_text: FEV会让你很痛，不过你不会死。

text: 不管是你的肉体还是灵魂都将属于我们。
source_text: 不管是你的肉体还是灵魂都将属于我们。
